title: Verify: Committed manifest boy entries match generated output unit tests
summary: Unit test that manifest.json boy entries equal generator output
description: Import manifest.json and compare boy entries to the pure generator output; assert the old boy entry is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Boy sheet and portrait entries match generated entries
character:boy still points to the svg
technical_constraints: Read manifest through a JSON import, no real fs and no app start

steps.action: Import manifest from '../public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json' and generateAssets, BOY_SOURCES. For each entry from generateAssets(BOY_SOURCES).entries, expect manifest.assets.find(a=>a.id===entry.id) toEqual entry and path to end with '.png'. Also expect the asset with id 'character:boy' to have a path ending '.svg'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/boyManifestFile.test.ts
